plan.objective: Re-smoke FalseGreen 0.10.0 end-to-end on the ledger demo: the falsegreen.toml invariant set captures every implemented behavior claim (DESIGN.md sections 1-10 + README exit-code contract + threat-model scope), the baseline run is accepted with all five security witnesses carrying real evidence, and three dedicated break workspaces prove the SCA (#10), SAST (#14), and secret (#12) classes now actually gate the verdict; the HTML/PDF report parity (#13) and the invariant carry (#7) are re-observed on the signed artifacts.
constraints: payloads must pass the local D0 secret gate so publish proceeds (the secret payload is below the D0 threshold by construction — the whole point of #12)
at most one heavy job in flight; queue is single-slot
assumptions: the server's OSV snapshot is fresh within 24h (freshness_hours bound in the frozen policy)

each break run uses a dedicated workspace copy with its payload committed (smallvec 1.6.0 pin; a Python allow_pickle payload hitting an error-default SARIF rule; a planted below-D0-threshold secret token)
no contract criteria change — only the invariant sections are new
